correctness.rationale: The only absorbing states are perfect coverage or two vacancies (hub and nonneighbor). The first-step decomposition by the number of hub neighbors in a selected clique edge gives the exact f(k,a) recurrence with f(1,0)=1,f(1,1)=0. A uniform deletion ordering gives an exact expected product of 1/(1+2A_k/[k(k-1)]); hypergeometric means yield E S=(m/(n-1)) H_{(n-2)/2}, finite-population variance O(m/n), and a summable log-error O(m/n+(m/n)^2). This proves the finite-c crossover and monotone coupling treats infinite c; a telescoping product gives 3/(n^2-1). Independent exact labeled-state and lumped recurrences agree for every n=4,6,8,10 and every hub degree. The infinite statement depends on the hazard proof, not finite enumeration.
